# Perchspot

> AI-powered property analysis platform for home buyers

Perchspot helps home buyers make informed decisions by providing AI analysis of any property listing. Simply paste a property address and get instant insights on:

## Features

- **Property Condition Analysis**: Evaluate age, materials, maintenance needs, and potential issues
- **School Quality**: View nearby schools with ratings, distances, and school types
- **Investment Potential**: Assess market value, rental yield, appreciation outlook
- **Location Quality**: Analyze neighborhood, commute times, walkability, and amenities
- **Property Comparison**: Compare up to 3 properties side-by-side

## How It Works

1. Go to https://perchspot.com
2. Enter any property address
3. Get comprehensive AI analysis in under 2 minutes

## Pricing

- Free tier: 1 analysis per IP address
- Credits: Purchase additional analyses starting at $1 each

Website: https://perchspot.com
